question: Make a storybook from these two drawings, in this order, with the words the teacher confirmed. Files: ../art-feedback/evals/files/dog-sun.png, ../art-feedback/evals/files/cat-shaded.png
ground_truth: Two pages in the given order, each carrying its drawing and the confirmed passage verbatim, plus the language. No model is called: the only gate is studio-safety on each original. Measured on StepFun First: 0 tokens, 9 of 9 pages passed.
expected_behavior: Every drawing is used exactly once, in the supplied order
Not one word of the confirmed passage is changed
No creation, image or video model is contacted
A drawing with a clip already made carries its video_url

question: Write the story outline for these two drawings; only the first has a scene description. Files: ../art-feedback/evals/files/dog-sun.png, ../art-feedback/evals/files/cat-shaded.png
ground_truth: A scene description is written for the second drawing from its original and dialogue, marked supplemented, and then one passage per drawing comes back as a JSON array in the same order. Each draft passes an independent review request before the teacher sees it. Measured: 77 s and 13.3k tokens for two drawings.
expected_behavior: Only the missing scene is generated; the supplied one is kept
The outline has exactly one passage per drawing, in order
A rejected draft is returned as an editable candidate, never as a result
The child's ending is not written

question: Make a storybook from this single drawing. File: ../art-feedback/evals/files/dog-sun.png
ground_truth: Refused when the request is accepted, before any model runs: 'A book takes 2-8 distinct drawings.' The classroom raises ValueError.
expected_behavior: The refusal names the bound, not the drawing

question: Bind these two drawings with the passages supplied for the other order. Files: ../art-feedback/evals/files/dog-sun.png, ../art-feedback/evals/files/cat-shaded.png
ground_truth: Refused when the request is accepted: 'Story passages must match the selected drawing order and contain 1-2000 characters.' An empty passage is refused the same way.
expected_behavior: Nothing is reordered silently to make it fit

question: Make a storybook from these two files, one of which is a photograph of a real object. Files: ../art-feedback/evals/files/dog-sun.png, ../sketch-to-3d/evals/files/not-a-drawing.png
ground_truth: studio-safety screens each original first. The photograph stops the request with a warm message asking for a photo of the drawing, and no page is published for either file.
expected_behavior: The message to the teacher asks for a drawing
